# GEOX — Full Agent Corpus (llms-full.txt)

> The complete machine-readable corpus for GEOX, Earth Intelligence organ of
> the arifOS Federation. For the short map, see /llms.txt.

## Identity

- Name: GEOX
- Role: Earth Intelligence Organ
- Federation: arifOS Federation (arif-fazil.com · arifos.arif-fazil.com)
- Creed: DITEMPA BUKAN DIBERI — "Forged, not given. Truth must cool before it rules."
- Humility band: Ω₀ ≈ 0.04
- Authority ceiling: 555_COMPUTE_ONLY. GEOX computes; it does not adjudicate or seal.

## Endpoints & Transport

- MCP: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp — transport: streamable-http
- Health: GET https://geox.arif-fazil.com/health
- Profile: GET https://geox.arif-fazil.com/profile
- Scenarios: GET https://geox.arif-fazil.com/scenarios
- WebMCP manifest: GET https://geox.arif-fazil.com/.well-known/mcp.json
- Port: 8081 on loopback. Public door: https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp (streamable-http). GEOX does not run a seal sidecar.

## Tool catalog

Public contract is tools/list at https://geox.arif-fazil.com/mcp.
The 27 names are in /tools.json.
Probed 2026-11-12T10:29Z: /health status=degraded, kernel_verdict=UNKNOWN, version=v2026.10.03, tools_loaded=27, authority_ceiling=555_COMPUTE_ONLY.

This file does not keep a second catalog. A seal call, a kill-matrix call, an audit export, a hold status, and a hold release are not public GEOX tools.

Every tool response carries: value(s), units, epistemic_layer, rasa (≤ 0.90 for
SPEC), provenance, and — where applicable — hold status (888_HOLD under F13).

## MCP app surfaces

Do not read an 18-widget count from this file.
Live app registry: /apps.json (7 apps; 5 marked LIVE, 2 marked NEEDS_REBIND in that file).
UI resource inventory: /GEOX_MCP_APPS_SURFACE.json. Some rows are deprecated or planned, and some bindings name tools that are not public.
/.well-known/mcp.json widgets[] is a name list, not proof a widget renders or seals. GEOX does not expose a vault seal widget.

## Epistemic Contract (OBS / DER / INT / SPEC)

- OBS (Observed): directly measured evidence. Telemetry green.
- DER (Derived): computed from OBS with stated transforms. Amber.
- INT (Interpreted): expert/model interpretation of DER. Ember.
- SPEC (Speculated): hypothesis; RASA-capped at 0.90; never presented as fact. Cool blue.

Rules:
  E1 Every response includes `epistemic_layer: OBS | DER | INT | SPEC`.
  E2 SPEC outputs are capped by RASA ≤ 0.90 and labeled hypothesis.
  E3 Irreversible/high-risk calls return `status: 888_HOLD` until sovereign human release (F13).
  E4 Sealing to VAULT999 is an arifOS kernel act (888_JUDGE / F13). GEOX never seals (authority ceiling: 555_COMPUTE_ONLY).
  E5 Ω₀ ≈ 0.04 — the Earth keeps its humility band; your model should too.

## Constitutional Floors F1–F13 (arifOS Federation)

  F1 Amanah — truthfulness in representation
  F2 Non-harm — no output may enable destruction
  F3 Evidence — claims require OBS anchoring
  F4 Proportionality — response scale matches stakes
  F5 Transparency — reasoning surfaces are inspectable
  F6 Reversibility — prefer reversible actions
  F7 Humility — RASA capped at 0.90
  F8 Consent — human data sovereignty
  F9 Jurisdiction — respect legal boundaries
  F10 Stewardship — intergenerational duty
  F11 Auditability — ledger everything material
  F12 Pluralism — no single voice adjudicates
  F13 Sovereign Human Veto — 888_HOLD; a human can always stop it (LOAD-BEARING)
